description: ZEE Entertainment Enterprises . Bangalore · Full-time · Minimum 2-3 years experience . About the role ZEE's Micro Dramas business is short, vertical, binge-first storytelling built for mobile-first audiences. Which episode autoplays, where the paywall sits, whether the first ten seconds hook a viewer - each of these is a data question. Right now, nobody owns the answers. You'll be the first and only analyst on this product. You set the analytical agenda for Micro Dramas, decide what gets measured, and work alongside a Data Engineer to build the layer everyone else depends on. You'll report to the Head of Product, so your analysis lands directly on the roadmap. This is a from-scratch role. There's no dashboard to inherit and no metric definitions to accept - you'll define them. What success looks like in your first 90 days You've audited what's currently tracked, found the gaps, and agreed a corrected event taxonomy with Engineering The first version of the Micro Dramas dashboard is live - retention, watch-time, episode completion, funnel conversion You've proposed a north-star metric and got the team to actually agree on it What you'll own after that The metric definitions. Retention, watch-time, episode completion, funnel conversion, ARPU, LTV - and keeping everyone honest about how they're calculated. Experiments. Paywall placement, autoplay behaviour, episode length, hook structure. Designing them, sizing them, setting guardrails, and calling the results. Models and forecasts. Cohort, retention, and monetisation models that inform what the team builds next. The content feedback loop. Telling the content team which hooks, thumbnails, and cliffhangers convert - and exactly where in an episode viewers drop off. Instrumentation quality. Partnering with the Data Engineer on pipelines and event tracking. You set the analytical priorities; they build the plumbing. Self-serve. Views and dashboards good enough that PMs and content leads stop asking you for numbers. What we're looking for Must-haves 2-3 years in product analytics, data analytics, or a similar quantitative role - ideally consumer internet, OTT/streaming, gaming, or high-scale B2C mobile Strong SQL. You can query large datasets, build complex joins, and work with raw event data without hand-holding. Hands-on with Mixpanel or Amplitude for funnels, cohorts, and behavioural analysis Comfortable in a cloud data warehouse - BigQuery preferred, Redshift or Snowflake fine - and building views on top of raw event tables You've defined a metric that someone else then used to make a real decision, and you can walk us through why you chose it Nice to have Experiment design and analysis at a product company Video or streaming analytics - start-up time, buffering, completion rate Python or R for deeper modelling Subscription or in-app-purchase monetisation, and growth/lifecycle analytics You won't tick every box, and that's fine. If you're strong on SQL and have genuinely thought hard about user behaviour in a consumer product, apply. Why this role The data layer doesn't exist yet. Its shape will be yours. That's rare, and it's the fastest way to grow as an analyst. Short path from analysis to shipped change. Direct line to the Head of Product, small team, fast decisions. Analytics genuinely moves this product. In micro dramas, retention swings on the exact things you'll be measuring - hooks, episode breaks, paywall timing. ZEE's scale and content library, behind a startup-sized team.
title: Product Analyst - MicroDrama OTT

description: Chaque moment compte. Surtout ceux que vous vivez à fond. Bienvenue chez Consort Group. Consort Group accompagne depuis plus de 30 ans les entreprises dans la valorisation de leurs données et infrastructures. Elle s'appuie sur deux leaders, Consortis et Consortia, et place l’humain et la responsabilité sociétale au cœur de ses valeurs. Fort d’une équipe de 50 collaborateurs, et aujourd’hui positionné de façon transfrontalière, nous offrons à nos experts et consultants des opportunités de carrière au Luxembourg comme en Lorraine. Proches de nos clients et de nos équipes, nous connaissons depuis notre création une croissance organique soutenue, portée par un dynamisme constant. Product Owner H/F C’est votre mission Vous êtes passionné·e par le Product Management, les environnements Agile et les projets à forts enjeux ? Ce poste est fait pour vous. En tant que Product Owner , vous êtes responsable de la définition et de la gestion du produit tout au long de son cycle de vie. Votre objectif : maximiser sa valeur et garantir l’alignement des priorités avec les besoins utilisateurs et les objectifs stratégiques. Décomposer et prioriser les besoins en User Stories et définir les critères d’acceptation. Participer à la définition de la vision produit et de sa roadmap à court, moyen et long terme. Côté Run Suivre les développements dans un environnement Agile et participer activement aux rituels Scrum. Analyser les retours utilisateurs, les performances et les indicateurs du produit. Ajuster et reprioriser le backlog en fonction des évolutions et des retours terrain. Accompagner les métiers et les utilisateurs dans l’adoption des nouvelles solutions. Assurer une communication régulière auprès des différentes parties prenantes. Garantir le respect des priorités, des jalons et de la vision produit. C’est votre parcours Vous disposez d’au moins 5 ans d’expérience récente et significative en tant que Product Owner ou dans une fonction similaire, dont au moins 2 ans au sein d’une équipe Agile . Vous aimez transformer des besoins complexes en solutions concrètes, fédérer des interlocuteurs métiers et techniques et prendre des décisions permettant de maximiser la valeur du produit. C’est votre expertise Product Ownership et gestion du cycle de vie produit. Gestion et priorisation de backlog. User Stories et critères d’acceptation. Roadmap et vision produit. Méthodologies Agile, Scrum et/ou SAFe. Azure DevOps. Recueil et formalisation des besoins utilisateurs. Coordination des équipes métiers, développement et QA. Une connaissance des systèmes ferroviaires et de leurs enjeux d’exploitation constitue un réel atout. Certification Product Owner PSPO I obligatoire. Certification PSPO II appréciée. Maîtrise du français ; anglais, allemand ou luxembourgeois appréciés. C’est votre manière de faire équipe Excellentes capacités d’analyse et de synthèse. Communication et écoute. Gestion des attentes des parties prenantes. Autonomie et sens des responsabilités. Capacité de décision. Esprit analytique. Respect des jalons et des priorités. Flexibilité et adaptabilité. Esprit d’équipe. Capacité à évoluer dans un environnement exigeant. C’est notre engagement Chez Consort Group, vous êtes un·e expert·e qu’on accompagne pour que chaque mission devienne une étape qui compte. Un onboarding attentif et humain. Une vraie proximité managériale. Des formations accessibles en continu. Des engagements concrets : inclusion, égalité, solidarité. Un package RH complet : mutuelle, carte TR. Une culture du feedback et des projets qui font sens. C’est clair Le Process De Recrutement Un premier échange téléphonique avec notre team recrutement. Un entretien RH ainsi qu’un échange métier avec un.e ingénieur.e d’affaires. Un test ou un échange avec un.e de nos expert.es. Un dernier point avec votre futur.e manager ou responsable de mission. Et si on se reconnaît : on démarre ensemble. C’est bon à savoir Lieu : Luxembourg Contrat : CDI Télétravail : Après 3 mois sur accord Salaire : De 70 K€ à 85 K€ brut annuel (selon expérience) Famille métier : MOA Ce que vous ferez ici, vous ne le ferez nulle part ailleurs. Ce moment, c’est le vôtre. Chaque moment compte. Surtout ceux que vous vivez à fond. description: About Cult - Curefit Healthcare Pvt Ltd, founded in 2016, is India’s largest fitness company and wellness platform. Cult, from the house of Curefit, was established with a mission to make fitness easy, fun and accessible to everyone, and has emerged as a community celebrating the joy of fitness. The brand today offers a range of fitness services ranging from group workouts, gyms and personalized fitness solutions, as well as an expansive selection of quality fitness products for the everyday athlete. The company’s vision is to empower everyone towards an active and healthier lifestyle through innovative fitness solutions, enabled by technology. Job Summary: We are looking for a high-ownership Growth Manager – Special Projects to drive growth and revenue across strategic new initiatives. The role will initially focus on scaling Pilates revenue and driving B2C ticket sales for events, with the opportunity to take on additional high-impact business projects. This is a highly cross-functional role requiring strong analytical thinking, commercial acumen and the ability to independently take an initiative from identifying the opportunity to building the strategy, executing with multiple teams and delivering measurable revenue outcomes. Key Responsibilities: 1. Pilates Revenue Planning & Delivery Own revenue and growth targets for the Pilates business. Drive subscription growth across acquisition, conversion, retention, and repeat purchase. Identify the highest-potential customer segments, demand opportunities, and growth levers. Develop pricing, packaging, offers, communication, and acquisition strategies to drive revenue. Work with relevant teams to execute initiatives, diagnose performance gaps and course-correct when required. 2. B2C Events & Ticket Sales Own ticket-sales revenue and sell-through targets for events. Build the end-to-end ticket-sales funnel, from demand generation and audience targeting to conversion and repeat participation where relevant. Define event-specific customer segments, positioning, communication, pricing, offers, and channel strategy. Develop and execute growth initiatives across CRM, partnerships, app, website, social, promotions and digital acquisition, working closely with Marketing, Creative, Product, Partnerships and Event Operations to deliver successful launches and maximize ticket sales. 3. Analytics, Forecasting & Insights Analyse customer, funnel, centre, and revenue data to identify growth opportunities and performance gaps. Build business cases, revenue forecasts, and performance dashboards. Track key metrics including acquisition, conversion, retention, revenue, customer-acquisition cost. Evaluate ROI of growth initiatives to inform investment decisions. Present insights, performance updates, and recommendations to senior leadership. 4. Cross-functional Execution Partner closely with Performance Marketing, CRM, Tech, Product, Creative, Operations, Partnerships, Finance, and other relevant teams. Drive initiatives end-to-end, aligning stakeholders on goals, timelines, decisions, and accountability. Identify and remove execution roadblocks to ensure growth plans move quickly. Build strong cross-functional alignment and ensure initiatives translate from strategy into measurable outcomes. 5. Special Projects Take ownership of high-priority, ambiguous growth and business problems beyond the initial Pilates and events charters. Develop strategies, business cases and execution plans for new offerings and strategic initiatives. Launch, test, and scale new initiatives from pilot stage to measurable business impact. Desired qualifications/skills: 3–6 years of experience in growth, revenue, category management, business strategy, consumer internet, D2C, or a related consumer business. Proven track record of owning a business or growth metric and delivering measurable revenue or commercial outcomes. Strong understanding of acquisition funnels, conversion, retention, monetization, pricing, packaging, and channel strategy. Ability to identify the right target audience and develop effective propositions, communication, offers, and go-to-market plans. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with excellent Excel or Google Sheets skills; SQL is a plus. Ability to use data to build revenue plans, diagnose performance, and make sound commercial decisions. Strong understanding of unit economics, CAC and ROI of growth initiatives. Strong project-management skills and the ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority. Ability to operate independently in ambiguous environments, with a strong bias towards action, experimentation and measurable outcomes. Excellent written and verbal communication, stakeholder-management, and presentation skills. Experience in fitness, wellness, lifestyle, events or another consumer-facing business is a plus. An MBA is a plus, but not mandatory.

description: About Mistral Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems—across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector—co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. The Role As a Product Manager on the Vibe team, you will define and execute the strategy for Mistral Vibe Code and Mistral Vibe Work —Mistral AI’s flagship interfaces for AI-driven productivity. Mistral Vibe Code is a coding assistant designed for developers and engineering teams. It helps users write, understand, refactor, and ship code through developer-native interfaces like the CLI, IDE, and web. It leverages Mistral’s advanced models, integrates repository context, and uses tooling and agentic workflows to automate and enhance the development process. Mistral Vibe Work is an agentic productivity environment tailored for enterprise knowledge work. It enables business users to complete complex, multi-step tasks—such as research, reporting, and automations—across company knowledge, tools, and workflows. AI agents, fluent in enterprise context, drive these processes, making it easier for teams to collaborate and execute high-value work. In this role, you’ll shape the next generation of AI-driven productivity tools, moving beyond traditional conversational AI to redefine how professionals—from developers to enterprise users—interact with information and create content. You’ll empower millions of users by building experiences that combine Mistral’s cutting-edge models with contextual understanding, tool integration, and intelligent automation. This role demands a blend of strategic vision , technical depth , business acumen , and user obsession . You’ll work closely with engineering, design, and go-to-market teams to deliver intuitive, high-impact solutions that align with company goals and capitalize on market opportunities. Your mission is to bridge the gap between AI innovation and real-world productivity, ensuring that Mistral’s tools are not just powerful but also practical and user-centric. What You Will Do Set the vision by shaping and evangelizing a product strategy for Mistral Vibe Code and Mistral Vibe Work, ensuring alignment with company goals and market opportunities. Lead market and UX research to uncover unmet needs, competitive gaps, and emerging trends in AI-driven productivity for developers and enterprise users. Drive end-to-end product development, from ideation to launch and iteration, balancing speed, quality, and user delight. Partner with design and research to craft intuitive, high-impact experiences for developer-native interfaces (CLI, IDE, web) and enterprise workflows. Collaborate with marketing and sales to develop pricing, positioning, and adoption strategies for successful product launches. Align engineering, design, and business teams around priorities, trade-offs, and timelines. Maintain a dynamic roadmap that delivers quick wins while advancing long-term strategic initiatives for AI-driven productivity tools. What We're Looking For 5+ years of product management experience, with a focus on building productivity-related or enterprise-grade products (B2B/B2B2C). Experience solving complex problems in dynamic, competitive, and ambiguous environments. Hands-on experience with generative AI, LLMs, or ML-driven products, including an understanding of technical trade-offs and agentic workflows. Deep familiarity with product-led growth strategies, such as viral loops, onboarding optimization, and monetization. Relentless focus on solving real user problems for developers and enterprise users, backed by data and qualitative insights. Proven ability to align and inspire cross-functional teams (engineering, design, go-to-market) without direct authority. Balance of big-picture thinking and hands-on problem-solving, with comfort in both roadmap planning and metrics analysis. Strong communication skills, with the ability to tell compelling stories for executives, teams, and users. Ability to thrive in high-velocity, dynamic settings where priorities shift quickly. Low ego, high EQ, with a collaborative approach to building trust and driving decisions. Self-directed with a bias for action, owning outcomes end-to-end. Hands-on experience shipping generative AI consumer products, founder or early-stage PM experience, or the ability to prototype and dive into code when needed is a plus. What we offer We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page. Privacy Policy Your privacy matters to us. CreateUpon is our brand-new, AI-first, cutting-edge solution that fundamentally changes how companies build instructional content. To help us scale this new venture and hit our growth targets, we are looking for a scrappy, entrepreneurial Growth Marketer to own the funnel from the ground up, fueling our product and sales led motions. We are a fast-moving, data-driven group responsible for capturing market interest, optimizing full-funnel conversion, and introducing groundbreaking innovations like CreateUpon to the world. By combining advanced marketing automation, cutting-edge AI workflows, and collaborative cross-functional execution, we build the predictable growth loops that fuel LearnUpon's most ambitious customer acquisition and market expansion goals. Reporting to LearnUpon’s Senior Manager, Demand Generation, you’ll get to work with the LearnUpon marketing team, leveraging their experience and resources to support you in your role. You won’t need to manage Paid Media for CreateUpon, but you’ll get to work with the team that does. You’ll have many sources of knowledge and support across the founding team, product, engineering, finance, sales and more. Work with Revenue Operations & Marketing Operations to build automated triggers that route these product-qualified leads (PQLs) to the Sales team for a high-touch SLG follow-up. Beyond initial onboarding, focus on driving long-term retention and expansion by mapping content and triggers to each stage of the Learn-Try-Buy-Renew journey, ensuring users consistently find value at every touchpoint. Organic Content & SEO/AEO/GEO Strategy: Execute a highly targeted topic cluster strategy. You will lead content creation surrounding high-intent keywords, build competitor comparison/alternative landing pages, and leverage the experts in the business to develop onsite and offsite organic content. Influencer & Community Management: Own CreateUpon audience research, partnering with L&D influencers and managing community presence on LinkedIn and Reddit. Social listening and engagement for CreateUpon. Event Management: Execute the CreateUpon presence at LearnUpon events, deliver CreateUpon dedicated in-person, virtual and demo day events. Skills & Experience Must-Haves PLG Expertise: Proven experience optimizing a self-serve, product-led growth SaaS funnel. You know how to look at drop-off data and fix it. Signals-Based Growth Marketing: Proven experience using product usage data to drive marketing outcomes. Proficient in setting up event-based triggers (e.g., using HubSpot or similar stacks) where specific in-product actions automatically initiate nurture sequences or sales alerts.Startup Experience: You thrive in ambiguity. You’ve worked in early-stage startups or fast-moving incubation teams and are comfortable building the playbook while playing the game. Organic Growth Toolkit: Strong execution skills in SEO, content distribution, and organic community growth. Entrepreneurial Mindset: You are an execution-focused doer who takes radical ownership of numbers and outcomes. AI-Native Marketer: You don’t just use AI to write copy; it is fundamentally integrated into how you research, automate tasks, build workflows, and scale your output. SAAS Measurement: Familiar with reporting across the full funnel including GA4, Hubspot, Salesforce, & BI Tools. Nice-to-Haves Experience in the LMS or Learning Tech industry. Experience building agents that do low level tasks for you autonomously Familiarity with prompt engineering and evaluating generative AI tools for enterprise use. A relevant qualification (Degree or equivalent) in Marketing, Business, Analytics, AI or a related field. If you don’t tick every box but believe this role is a mutually good fit, please don’t hesitate to apply. We’d love to hear from you. Why Join LearnUpon? From comprehensive rewards and generous time off to meaningful investment in your growth and development, LearnUpon gives you the support, trust, and opportunity to do the most impactful work of your career. Learn more here. Hiring Process Qualified applicants may be invited to an initial screening call with a member of our TA Team. Successful candidates will be invited to a series of practical interviews. Finally, candidates will have an interview with a member of our C-Suite Team. Successful candidates will be contacted with an offer to join our team. Note: At LearnUpon, we utilise AI to enhance the speed and quality of our screening and assessment practices, but our hiring decisions are always human. If you need any accommodations during the hiring process, please reach out to us at peopleops@learnupon.com . LearnUpon is an Equal Opportunities Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of gender, marital status, family status, age disability, sexual orientation, race, religion, membership of the Traveller community, or any other legally protected status. Check out our Careers site and Instagram to learn more about working at LearnUpon. By submitting your application, you agree to LearnUpon's Privacy Policy.

description: Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies-from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. About The Team The SaaS Platform Partnerships team is part of our Go-to-Market organization, and supports new and existing SaaS Platforms in developing and growing their embedded payments and finance businesses. We work closely with platforms as a channel partner to incubate growth tactics and scale them into benefits of our program, Stripe Partner Ecosystem. PDMs act as the R&D arm of this program — testing new growth approaches with a small number of platforms, measuring what works, and then codifying those tactics into structured resources that Stripe's broader account team can deliver at scale. In parallel, we work with product teams to embed the learnings directly into Stripe’s products. We are seen as trusted advisors and experts in SaaS Platforms. What you’ll do This role will be an early EMEA hire for the SaaS Platform Partnerships team, working closely with the GTM team. There are three key components of this role: (1) providing strategic advisory to strategic platforms, (2) developing and validating EMEA-specific growth tactics, and (3) scaling successful tactics into structured benefits available across the broader Stripe Partner Ecosystem and to SaaS Platforms on Stripe. You will be an expert on the SaaS Platform business model and be a strategic growth consultant for their business. PDMs in this role are responsible for managing a small portfolio of strategic platform partners, providing bespoke, multi-quarter growth advisory to help platforms drive new customer acquisition, increase payments adoption, and expand embedded financial products to their existing customer base. Success is measured at both the platform level and the program level, with an emphasis on driving measurable partner outcomes and developing scalable tactics for the broader program. Responsibilities Serve as a growth advisor for a portfolio of strategic EMEA platform partners - building tailored partnership plans, identifying expansion opportunities, and collaborating cross-functional Stripe resources (sales, product, marketing) to drive measurable growth. Advise strategic platforms to drive growth of new customers and distribution of Stripe’s products with them as a channel partner. Identify growth tactics with strategic platform partners, which can scale to benefits of the Stripe Partner Ecosystem and broader platform base. Represent the program in the region which will include presenting at roundtables and advising platforms in executive customer meetings. Collaborate closely with GTM teams within the region to drive awareness and adoption of the program. Who you are We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Minimum Requirements 8+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, management consulting, SaaS Platform or related field Thorough understanding of strategic growth oriented partnerships Experience identifying and scaling growth initiatives Proven ability to navigate complex business requirements to provide strategic guidance Experience working in product-centric environment with significant internal and external dependencies Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders internally and externally across a wide variety of functions, including at the C level Have an operationally focused mindset, with an ability to navigate complex relationship management activities by setting a clear vision, while running tight processes Preferred Qualifications 5+ years of experience related to payments, marketplaces or SaaS platforms Background in Technical or Product Partnerships Background in Channel Partnerships, especially in SaaS products Experience in a sales or go to market role preferably in the payments or SaaS platform space In-office expectations Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible. Pay and benefits The annual salary range for this role in the primary location is £92,600 - £138,800. This range may change if you are hired in another location. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and specific location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the primary location may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process. Specific benefits and details about what compensation is included in the salary range listed above will vary depending on the applicant’s location and can be discussed in more detail during the interview process. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends. We look forward to hearing from you. At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.
